notes.title: Early Access Update 0.3.0
notes.content:
First of all a cordial welcome to all new the people that joined recently ːp2cubeː

Many things have happened in the last 2 weeks and our Steam sale was a success:

We unlocked a whopping 6 stretch goals
Our Discord server grew by 1500 people
276 new Steam reviews (90% positive)
We were placed #3 top selling in the Early Access category
We answered several thousand emails & comments resulting from our marketing efforts

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023743/6b125ea088fac75512d3350abf11fe18896cf903.png
All that gives us the confidence that the final game will be a major success if we stay on course together with our awesome community ːwinter2019coolyulː

Now to the update!
Since we were mostly busy with marketing efforts and replying to messages the amount of changes is moderate but we are still excited to give you access to a new arena called "Embershard Factories"!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023743/3933e20b0eee1382894c1e214a98fe049b641257.png

ADDED

Arena: Embershard Factory

CHANGED

Gameplay: Zoom speed increased
Gameplay: Bots attack more naturally
Gameplay: Reduced volume of hit register sound
Drone Editor: Improved drone loading times in matches (currently just Test Flight)
Drone Editor: Online Test Flight tier limit reduced from 5 to 4
Drone Editor: Adjusted Defense/Armor component properties

FIXED

General: Game crash if Steam fails to initialize
General: Typos in the welcome message
Graphics: Soft shadows flickering
Drone Editor: Some drones could not be saved
Drone Editor: Weapon fire direction when camera is pointing in a different angle
Drone Editor: Block colors being rendered black in Test Flight
Drone Editor: Test Flight match results were taken into account

notes.content:
You can now take your custom drones into online test flight! To do this, go to the Drone Editor, load your drone and click "Test Flight".

Also, the game is on sale for 84% off -- tell your friends!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023743/e626bbe8bdf60d22da894b2f87454e86849bd07a.png

Drone Editor: Test Flight online mode
Drone Editor: Test Flight screenshot mode
(press Shift+P during Test Flight)

IMPROVED

Drone Editor: 3rd person camera setup

FIXED

Drone Editor: various bugs


Click here to check our roadmap in case you've missed it.

notes.title: Roadmap
notes.content:
As most of you know, when we are quiet big stuff is coming... and we have been too quiet ;)

We have a BIG ANNOUNCEMENT to make TOMORROW so definitely stay tuned and check our channels!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023743/2f60e34e4628a428da81c7946f54c74020b221af.png

In the meantime, to clarify the immediate next steps, our short-term roadmap looks as follows (ETA 1-2 weeks):

Editor-built drones will be able to battle against bots in test flight
More components will be functional (power generators, batteries, etc)

Soon after that:

ENVIRONMENTS - SPACE (reached stretch-goal)
MOAR WEAPONS (reached stretch-goal)

Then:

Editor-built drones will be usable in multiplayer
Progression system

Independently of these timeframes, new, more dynamic arenas will roll out as well.
Pssst! [spoiler]BIG ANNOUNCEMENT TOMORROW. Don't forget.[/spoiler] See ya :D

notes.title: Update 0.1.82
notes.content:
Greetings Operators!

You may have noticed that even though there was a lack of announcements, many updates were made (34 to be precise!), so here's what's new since the last announcement!

[previewyoutube=NdSaydiIuYU;full][/previewyoutube]

NEW

Arena: Echo Outpost
Arena: Illumina Seven
Arena: Cavity Five
Bullet holes and decals
Bots in multiplayer
Soundtrack: Spheres by Vellocx (also available on your rewards page)
Kill-cam
Customizable hud
Missile indicators


IMPROVED

Drone physics
Drones don't always explode immediately when destroyed
Drone flags in multiplayer
Health packs heal over time instead of instantly
Sticky bombs have team colors
Graphics and performance
Arena borders act as solid walls instead of "sponges"
Team colors: you're always blue and enemies are always red
Current target and leading aim indicators are orange
Drone headlight
Upgraded to the latest Unity3d LTS release


FIXED

Everything that wasn't working


See you in-game, on the Steam Community Hub, and on our Discord! ;)

P.S: If you enjoy the game please consider leaving a review!

notes.title: Update 0.1.47
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023743/a18fb6d09e6d98f2bd254d4a8597fefa189bba15.png

0.1.47 is out and it has changed Powerball gameplay! No more goals. Keep the ball in your team's possession for as long as possible in order to have more points than the enemy team.

Tier 3 (Explorer) now have access to the full drone editor and Tier 2 (Traveler) have access to block building.

For more changelog info as well as next steps, see https://trello.com/b/FACZfxiI
